Change.description:
Whether the project has changed a template, or a file of one, since the
copy.

oneOf.description: The file is what was written.
The file isn't what was written.
Nothing is remembered of what was written, so it can't be told.

FileKind.description: Which of a template's files a file is.

oneOf.description: The template, which a page is copied from.

FileStatus.description: A file of a template the project took.

kind.description: Which of the template's files it is.

matches_set.description:
Whether the file is the set's text now; null when it isn't there, or
the set doesn't have it.

path.description: The file, from the folder `ascribe.toml` is in.

project.description: Whether the project has changed the file since the copy.

sections.description:
What's different in the set by section, when the set changed it and
the project didn't, so the file is what was written; otherwise null.

upstream.description: Whether the set's text has changed since the copy.

NotTaken.description: A template of the set the project doesn't have.

oneOf.description: An entry, with a hash of each file as written.
There's no `templates.lock` where it was looked for.
The lock is there, and has no entry for it.
The lock is there, and isn't one eject wrote.

SectionChange.description: A section that's different in the set.

heading.description:
The section's heading, as written; null for what comes before the
first heading, frontmatter included.

SectionChangeKind.description: How a section is different in the set.

oneOf.description: The set has it, and the copy doesn't.
The copy has it, and the set doesn't.
Both have it, with different text.

SetRelease.description: Which release of theirs a set was converted from.

TemplateStatus.description: A template the project took: its lock entry, its type, or both.

copied_from.description:
Their release the copy was made from, as the lock records it; null
without an entry.

files.description: Its files: the template, their guide, and Ascribe's notes.

lock.description:
The lock its entry is in, or the one looked in when there's no entry,
from the folder `ascribe.toml` is in.

lock_problem.description:
Why the lock can't be read, when `record` is `invalid_lock`; otherwise
null.

name.description: Its name, which is its type's.

project.description:
Whether the project has changed its copy: `changed` when any of its
files has, or is gone.

upstream.description:
Whether the set has changed it since the copy: `changed` when any of
its files has.

UpstreamChange.description: Whether the set has changed a template, or a file of one, since the copy.

oneOf.description: The set's text is what was written.
The set's text isn't what was written.
Nothing is remembered of what was written, so it can't be told.
The set no longer has it.

description:
What `ascribe templates status` found: for each template the project
took, whether the set and the project have changed it since the copy, and
each template of the set it doesn't have.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

not_taken.description:
Each template of the set the project doesn't have, in the set's
order.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

set.description: The set this `ascribe` carries, which the copies are compared with.

templates.description:
Each template the project took, in the set's order, then any the set
no longer has, by name.

upstream_changed.description:
Whether a file of a template the project took has changed in the set
since the copy, as `templates.lock` remembers it. What `--exit-code`
exits with 1 for.
